unlisted_practices: Evidence-aware active diagnosis scaffold with role-specialized agents and evidence tools
Observer-guided runtime harness that regulates diagnostic termination by tracking uncertainty and evidence coverage
Synthesizing interactive patient-specific diagnostic environments from raw clinical cases

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an agentic LLM architecture (EviDx) for dynamic clinical diagnosis. Novel model or agent architecture development tested on benchmark cases without evaluating health system deployment practices is not classified as testing a deployment practice.
